headline: Meta patches zero-day flaw in its Muse AI assistant
summary: A zero-day vulnerability in Meta's Muse AI app, discovered by security researcher Patrick Wardle, let local attackers redirect dictation processing and potentially take broader control of a victim's Mac. Meta has issued a patch fixing the flaw.
